name: week
title: Research week
subtitle: Read-only research operations. Fictional when seeded.

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from research_attention order by due_date,code

sections.title: Experiments
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,state,due_on,current_review from experiment_position order by due_on,code

sections.title: Evidence position
sections.sql: select code,protocol,entries,artifacts,open_actions,current_review from experiment_position order by code

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from research_compliance order by code,rule

sections.title: Archive inventory
sections.sql: select a.code,f.relative_path,f.bytes,f.title,f.missing_links from archives a join archive_files f on f.archive_id=a.id order by a.code,f.relative_path

sections.title: Retention decisions
sections.sql: select code,owner,storage_ref,policy_ref,retain_until,backup_verified_on from projects order by code
